steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Hey. It's me, Aerlie.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Did you hear the broadcast from camp just now...? Oh right, I'm still out on a job, about a day from Iron Carrot City.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Yeah! I thought I'd be back home in a couple days, but we got news earlier today that our survey team has to head to a deeper mining area after resupplying at the transport hub.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: *sigh*... Not like you can argue with the company when they tell you to go. Plus, they assigned me to be the escort, so what am I gonna do?

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Anyway, I won't be able to go to the party with you this week. Real sorry about that.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Well of course it's a bit of a shame. We've all been looking forward to it, especially considering how much time and effort it took to lock down that abandoned ore warehouse for a venue.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: I guess the bit of silver lining is I finished my portion of the prep work early. At least me not being able to show up won't mess with everyone else's plans.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: *sigh*... Yeah, we'll have another chance someday...

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: The weather should be a lot warmer for our next party at least. Then, we'll finally get to wear the dresses we bought last time.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: You've been looking forward to that too, haven't you? I even bought a pair of matching earrings.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Oh, that reminds me, you said you guys were rehearsing one of my favorite songs, to perform for me as a surprise at the party. But since I can't be there... do you think you could tell me which one it is?

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: ...How am I supposed to guess? The bands that I like can't be counted on my two hands, and each one has a dozen awesome albums. There's no way I'd be able to pick just one favorite.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: You're not seriously going to make me wait until the next party, are you? What if the company sends me out long-term?

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: ...Ooh, you're right, that song is a great pick!

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: You guys are going to be my superstar pop group one day, so I can finally realize my dream of having a concert right on my doorstep.
The Cautus girl suddenly uses her hand to cover the communicator's receiver.

steps.name: Hunter's Voice
steps.text: Woah, the fancy little Cautus girl's here? You're joking, right? There's no way someone would hire her.

steps.name: Worker's Voice
steps.text: But, she's still a registered hunter. In principle, she's allowed to stay at the camp, though she usually acts alone...

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Oh, the team's about to leave. I was going to keep complaining about how much of a pain in the butt this mission is, but that'll have to wait 'til next time.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Okay, I'll contact you again once I get back to town.

steps.name: Hunter's Voice
steps.text: If I were her, I'd keep my head down and beat it as soon as I could. But seeing the flashy way she dresses, she's probably no different from before, haha...

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Yeah, I think I'll keep my earphones in while I'm on the road.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Okay, that clears the air up just right! Let's get some music going so I don't get sleepy on the road!

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Hrmm, where did I put the newest bounty list... Oh, yes, it says right here that manglers are worth the most around here.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Well, I don't know how to deal with those big monsters either... Never mind then.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: It used to be just driving them off was good enough. Now, we're looking for trouble in their part of the woods.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Good thing I'm just short of the earnings I need. As long as I catch a few fowlbeasts, I should be good to go.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: According to the company benefits program, I can use my savings to buy an old projector that the company retired. Then, I can lie in bed and watch the discs I bought.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Err, but maybe I shouldn't... Once I get enough money, I should probably find a way to live better. Maybe a rental with good sound insulation so I won't bug my neighbors after a long night's work, or when I move furniture around in the middle of the night.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Ugh, I'm no good with this long-term planning stuff...

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Movement.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Let's see if luck is on my side today... Wounded beasts always try to run, so let's see if the traps from the textbooks work or not.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Woah, it's a person! That was a close one––

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Uhh, excuse me–– I'm not your prey, okay? I'm a hunter! Look how conspicuously I'm dressed. What kind of beast looks like this?

steps.name: Bandit Leader
steps.text: We don't make mistakes. You are our prey.

steps.name: Bandit Leader
steps.text: Hand over any valuables you have on you, or we're gonna have to get a bit rough.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: *sigh*... Great, looks like I've got company after all...

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: There's one hiding in the trees over there, then another one by the rock behind me.

steps.name: Bandit Leader
steps.text: I'm going to count down from three. Show us the money, if you know what's good for you. Otherwise, don't expect to get off with just a single arrow.

steps.name: Bandit Leader
steps.text: Three.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: ...No can do.

steps.name: Bandit Leader
steps.text: Two.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: I worked hard to scrounge up this little bit of money.

steps.name: Bandit Leader
steps.text: One.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Let's see if you can catch me, instead!

steps.name: Grocery Store Owner
steps.text: Oh, Aerlie, you're back again?

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Sure am. I finally finished tidying up my place. Didn't expect there to be so much random stuff to get through, considering how small my room is.

steps.name: Grocery Store Owner
steps.text: Let me take a look... Oh my, these kinds of self-assembled storage cabinets aren't easy to sell second-hand, right? Plus, I see some tape marks.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Oh, that was an adhesive strip I stuck on the side of the cabinet. I had a makeshift full-length mirror there. I ended up tearing it off when I was having a bad day.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: You're right that it looks a bit tacky though... So it's okay if you drop the value a little.

steps.name: Grocery Store Owner
steps.text: Huh? This dress is still brand new, isn't it? Are you sure you want to sell it? Seems like a waste, if you ask me.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: A little bit... but that cut doesn't work for me. It's backless, and that's a no-go.

steps.name: Grocery Store Owner
steps.text: Your Oripathy... Is it growing on your back?

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Yeah...

steps.name: Grocery Store Owner
steps.text: Alright, I get it. You just moved here pretty recently, right?

steps.name: Grocery Store Owner
steps.text: I see you've been around here the last few days to sell stuff off. Did something happen?

steps.name: Grocery Store Owner
steps.text: We're all Infected around here. I can hear you out if you'd like, just between the two of us.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: It's nothing major. I just haven't been able to find work, and want to try my luck somewhere else.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: I can't lug these things around anyway, so might as well turn 'em into some cash.

steps.name: Grocery Store Owner
steps.text: *sigh*... You say you want to try your luck somewhere else, but how do you know a new place would be any better? Do you already have someplace in mind?

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Hmm... I saw an ad for a company and wanted to give it a shot. It's pretty far away though.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: I've already saved up enough money to get by in a new city. Now I just need enough to get a one-way ticket out of here.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: But don't worry, I've been budgeting carefully, so I've got everything I need.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Plus, even if I'm out of a job right now, I still have this bow. If my luck's good, I can maybe hunt some beasts just outside the city. Might even be able to fetch a decent price for the pelts and meat from the merchants in the camps.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Even if my luck's not so good... At least I don't see myself starving to death.

steps.name: Grocery Store Owner
steps.text: *sigh*... You're still so young, be careful when you're out there hunting. And please take the long way around if you run into any Originium clusters... You wouldn't want your condition getting any worse.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Haha, I was with the minecart team for how many years? Of course I know that by now.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: I actually used to think about buying a secondhand speaker or projector as soon as I managed to scrounge up some money. Now that I finally have the money, I didn't expect it to feel so...

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Well, that's not quite right. I barely have a thing to my name now, so that probably doesn't count as 'having money.'

steps.name: Grocery Store Owner
steps.text: Now that you've sold all this stuff off, I suppose you won't stick around much longer?

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Right. I'll be leaving tomorrow morning.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Ugh, didn't anyone teach those kids not to run with knives? They're awfully fast, too!

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: But if I hand over my luggage, I really won't have anything left... And that's no way to survive. So let's go another way.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: My luck sure ended up rotten, huh? It's all because I was short a little money for my ticket, and I didn't want to dip into living expenses... Otherwise, I wouldn't have to hunt anymore.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Hey, you guys hear me talking out loud too, can't you? Mind sparing a girl an ounce of sympathy?
Just as the blade of one of the bandits is about to reach her, the nimble Cautus hops into the air and climbs up a tree branch.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Aha, looks like those traps worked after all. Even managed to snag one of your crossbowmen in one.

steps.name: Bandit Leader
steps.text: Why you little––!

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: I wasn't planning on fighting, but now that you've fallen into my trap, you're my prey.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: I might look young, but I've trained in the ways of a hunter since I was little. I know a thing or two about archery and trapping too.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Here's a tip: these traps were made for beasts, so the harder you struggle, the more likely you are to hurt yourself.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: (Threats like that should be good enough, right? That's how they always do it on TV.)

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: (Ugh, I don't even know if there's a vigilante patrol around here, or a private security detail... Maybe I'll try asking for help once I get back to camp.)

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Phew... Can have a civil discussion now?

steps.name: Bandit Leader
steps.text: Wh-What are you going to do to us? If you want to keep things civil, why don't you put the bow down first?

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: I'm just making sure the trap's doing its job. If you don't mind, I'm going to head back to camp and find someone to take you away.

steps.name: Apprehensive Bandit
steps.text: P-Please, anything but that... We'll die.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Huh? You're that afraid of getting turned in? Have you been doing that much robbing?

steps.name: Apprehensive Bandit
steps.text: No, but...

steps.name: Bandit Leader
steps.text: We're all sick. Infected.

steps.name: Bandit Leader
steps.text: You know what that means, Hunter. You said you didn't want to fight, but you don't sympathize with livestock, do you?

steps.name: Bandit Leader
steps.text: That's why they don't bother putting Infected on trial. We just go straight to...

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Hunter's Voice
steps.text: There was a time when I would've said she wasn't cut out to be a hunter. But now that she's Infected, she's not even in the same class as us. Hahaha!

steps.name: Hunter's Voice
steps.text: Think she has something going on with the commissioner? Who the hell is still giving her work?

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Why did you decide to become bandits?

steps.name: Bandit Leader
steps.text: What kind of question is that? We caught Oripathy and lost our jobs. We can't just roll over and die, can we?

steps.name: Bandit Leader
steps.text: Like most Infected, the three of us worked in the mines for a long, long time.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Um... What about the company's insurance coverage?

steps.name: Bandit Leader
steps.text: You talking about compensation for those who get infected on the job? Must've been stolen by the mine supervisor. Never heard of any Infected workers getting a single cent of compensation.

steps.name: Bandit Leader
steps.text: Judging from the fancy way you dress, you must be a sheltered little princess who's never seen an Infected? If you're out here looking to hand out condolences, I've got plenty of tragic stories for you.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: No, I'm just an ordinary girl. Extremely ordinary...

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: But, I did have a thought. If you know who took your compensation money, why not try to get it back from him?

steps.name: Mine Supervisor
steps.text: Come in.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: G'day. I'm a hunter assigned here to carry out an escort mission. Here's my registration certificate and my provisional assignment document.

steps.name: Mine Supervisor
steps.text: Huh? I don't think I've seen you before. And our hunter...

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Also, I have three companions ready to help me on the mission.

steps.name: Mine Supervisor
steps.text: What the hell are you talking about? How could––

steps.name: Mine Supervisor
steps.text: You again...

steps.name: Knife-Wielding Bandit
steps.text: We're just here to get our money back.

steps.name: Mine Supervisor
steps.text: P-Put that knife down... S-Someone, help me...

steps.name: Bandit Leader
steps.text: Save your breath. After you screwed us, we were forced to turn to banditry. Now, we're not afraid to use these knives.

steps.name: Bandit Leader
steps.text: ...Is this really going to work?

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: I'm sure of it.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: To sum things up, I'll go to the camp first to ask around and see if any of the hunters are going to the mine soon, to get a general grasp of the mission.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Then, if any of them are nice enough and willing to help us out, we'll take their place and go into the mine. If they aren't willing to help... We'll just borrow their names and slip in before them.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Oh, but I'm actually no good with lying. You might have to help me smooth things out to sound convincing.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: After we get past the guards, we just have to avoid everyone along the way.

steps.name: Bandit Leader
steps.text: You sure make it sound easy.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Well, I am a hunter after all, and I'm good at staying hidden. The beasties never see me, even with how keen their senses are.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: If we are seen though, let me think... playing it cool is probably the best option. We don't look that suspicious, so it's not like strangers will remember our faces.

steps.name: Bandit Leader
steps.text: Heh. Alright then, I'll lead the way.

steps.name: Bandit Leader
steps.text: Hunter... why are you doing this for us? Do we look so pathetic you're taking pity on us?

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Uhh, I wouldn't put it that way...

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Maybe it's because I have a question I'd like answered.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Oh, by the way, can I still file a report with the company about the misappropriation of compensation funds?

steps.name: Mine Supervisor
steps.text: Fine, I'll hand it over. That's all you want, right? I'll give it all back...

steps.name: Bandit Leader
steps.text: Don't think we'll take an IOU or anything like that. I want to see cold, hard cash.

steps.name: Bandit Leader
steps.text: If we hadn't trusted you in the first place, you would've gotten a visit from us a long time ago.

steps.name: Mine Supervisor
steps.text: Eek... There's cash... in that safe over there... Here's the key.

steps.name: Bandit Leader
steps.text: Go fetch it. One portion each for the three of us.

steps.name: Apprehensive Bandit
steps.text: Sure... But can't we take a bit more?

steps.name: Bandit Leader
steps.text: It's just in case we get caught. Plus, I'd like to show this asshole what it means to have some dignity.

steps.name: Mine Supervisor
steps.text: You're just an Infected. What do you know about dignity?

steps.name: Mine Supervisor
steps.text: And that hunter over there... Who exactly are you? I thought you were here to ask for compensation too.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Oh... Actually, I just wanted to ask you a question.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Since you're not hurting for cash or anything, why would you take compensation money from the Infected who need it to survive?

steps.name: Mine Supervisor
steps.text: It's not like they'll ever be employable again, so the money would just vanish into thin air, right? It'd be a damn shame to waste perfectly good money on the Infected.

steps.name: Bandit Leader
steps.text: You're a real piece of shit.

steps.name: Bandit Leader
steps.text: Hunter, you went through all this effort just to ask that question?

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Well, not exactly. It's just... the thought never crossed my mind before.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Who stole my compensation money from the company, and why?

steps.name: Bandit Leader
steps.text: Yeah. Next, we'll probably head to a nearby town and try our luck again. Maybe someone will have something for us to do.

steps.name: Bandit Leader
steps.text: You're really not gonna go after the people who screwed you over?

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Uhh, I don't think it's even possible anymore. I never realized I was being screwed over in the first place, so I have no idea who to talk to about it now.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Plus, I'm ready to get out of here, and leave the past behind.

steps.name: Bandit Leader
steps.text: Right, you mentioned you were saving money for a ticket out.

steps.name: Bandit Leader
steps.text: Since you've done so much for us and spent so much of your time, let us repay you by covering the rest of your fare.

steps.name: Bandit Leader
steps.text: Though it's not exactly a king's ransom...

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Hah, you're pretty good people after all~

steps.name: Bandit Leader
steps.text: To be honest, I never guessed you'd be Infected too, with the way you ran up to that bastard just to ask such a basic question.

steps.name: Bandit Leader
steps.text: Did you get the answer you were looking for?

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Of course not. I didn't like what he said at all.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: But, a lot of people think just like him, right? They just don't take Infected people seriously, and without any good reason.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Even I...

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Huh...?

steps.name: Voice from the Communicator
steps.text: Woah, Aerlie, you actually picked up!

steps.name: Voice from the Communicator
steps.text: We just decided to try calling, but didn't think you'd actually be in a place with reception.

steps.name: Voice from the Communicator
steps.text: Can you hear? They're performing 'April' over here! They sound pretty scuffed, but you can really tell from your end, right?

steps.name: Voice from the Communicator
steps.text: Hehe, I guess you won't be missing out after all! To our dear Aerlie, thank you for laying the first cornerstone of the greatest art district in Iron Carrot City!

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Hahaha... *cough*, *cough*...
Aerlie, if you want to say goodbye to them in person, this is your last chance.
If you want to ask your friends if they'll still accept you despite being Infected, this is also the best chance for that. While you're not too distant, while your relationship is still tight-knit.
––Those thoughts cross through her mind, but the Cautus simply listens to the whole song while quietly gripping the communicator.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Pass on this message from me: As long as they keep practicing, they'll sound great!

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: All right, I guess that's that. You always remember to have fun now~

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Oh, the Infected guys already left.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Maybe if I get another chance someday, I'll write to my friends again and tell them what happened.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Since becoming Infected, I've never felt that level of warmth and kindness... and I want them to stay with me a bit longer.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: But at the end of the day, the most important thing is still... what I think about myself.

steps.name: Aerlie
steps.text: Well, time to go. I hope that company's advert isn't just empty promises.
